content.text:
raise Bad()
    obj, end = DECODER.raw_decode(text, i)
    while end < n and text[end] in JSON_WS:
        end += 1
    if end != n:
        raise Bad()
    root = _keys_exact(obj, ("version", "traces"))
    if not _bounded_int(root["version"], MAXN) or root["version"] != 1:
        raise Bad()
    traces = root["traces"]
    if type(traces) is not list:
        raise Bad()
    if len(traces) > LIM_TRACES:
        raise Bad()
    counts = [0, 0, 0, 0]          # events, packets, frames, decoded bytes
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for tr in traces:
        item = _parse_trace(tr, counts)
        if item[0] in seen:
            raise Bad()
        seen.add(item[0])
        out.append(item)
    return out


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# byte range bookkeeping
#
# ivs is a list of (start, end, bytes) tuples kept sorted by start and
# pairwise disjoint.  Already stored bytes are never overwritten, so an
# insertion only ever fills holes; that keeps undo (transaction rollback)
# cheap and exact.
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def store_insert(ivs, a, data, reject, journal):
    """Store data at [a, a+len(data)) into the sorted disjoint list ivs.

    Already stored bytes win, so only holes are inserted.  Returns False when
    the 'reject' policy sees a differing overlap (nothing is mutated then).
    """
    n = len(data)
    if n == 0:
        return True
    b = a + n
    i0 = bisect.bisect_left(ivs, (a,))
    if i0 > 0 and ivs[i0 - 1][1] > a:
        i0 -= 1
    i = i0
    last = len(ivs)
    covered = []
    conflict = False
    while i < last:
        s = ivs[i][0]
        if s >= b:
            break
        e = ivs[i][1]
        lo = s if s > a else a
        hi = e if e < b else b
        if not conflict and ivs[i][2][lo - s:hi - s] != data[lo - a:hi - a]:
            if reject:
                return False
            conflict = True
        covered.append((lo, hi))
        i += 1
    gaps = []
    pos = a
    for lo, hi in covered:
        if lo > pos:
            gaps.append((pos, lo, data[pos - a:lo - a]))
        pos = hi
    if b > pos:
        gaps.append((pos, b, data[pos - a:b - a]))
    if not gaps:
        return True
    merged = []
    j = i0
    k = 0
    ng = len(gaps)
    while j < i or k < ng:
        if k >= ng or (j < i and ivs[j][0] < gaps[k][0]):
            merged.append(ivs[j])
            j += 1
        else:
            merged.append(gaps[k])
            k += 1
    journal.append((3, ivs, i0, len(merged), ivs[i0:i]))
    ivs[i0:i] = merged
    return True


def store_deliver(ivs, pos):
    """Bytes of the contiguous run that starts at pos (may be empty)."""
    idx = bisect.bisect_left(ivs, (pos,))
    if idx > 0 and ivs[idx - 1][1] > pos:
        idx -= 1
    parts = None
    last = len(ivs)
    while idx < last:
        s, e, d = ivs[idx]
        if s > pos:
            break
        if e > pos:
            if parts is None:
                parts = [d[pos - s:e - s]]
            else:
                parts.append(d[pos - s:e - s])
            pos = e
        idx += 1
    if parts is None:
        return None
    if len(parts) == 1:
        return parts[0]
    return b"".join(parts)

class Stream(object):
    __slots__ = ("sid", "highest", "final", "reset", "stopped", "ivs",
                 "delivered")

    def __init__(self, sid):
        self.sid = sid
        self.highest = 0
        self.final = None
        self.reset = False
        self.stopped = False
        self.ivs = []
        self.delivered = bytearray()


class CStore(object):
    __slots__ = ("ivs", "contig", "highest")

    def __init__(self):
        self.ivs = []
        self.contig = bytearray()
        self.highest = 0

        self.idle_ms = cfg["idle_ms"]

        self.msu = cfg["msu"]
        self.msd = cfg["msd"]
        self.max_data = cfg["max_data"]
        self.clim = cfg["crypto_limit"]
        self.sent = cfg["sent"]

        self.keys = {"I": "live", "H": "absent",

        self.qcount = 0

        self.streams = {}
        self.cs = {"I": CStore(), "H": CStore(), "A": CStore()}
        self.received_total = 0

        self.state = "open"
        self.code = None
        self.at_ms = None
        self.source = None
        self.peer_code = None
        self.last_activity = 0
